basis_note: All figures Solo/Standalone basis from Islami Bank's own 'Five Years Performance' tables. Shariah terminology is mapped to conventional names: gross_loans is General Investment, net_interest_income is Net Investment Income, classified_loans is Classified Investment. Each year is taken from that year's own annual report except FY2011, FY2018 and FY2020, whose reports are unusable scans. See quarterly/*.json period_note for restatements.
